propositions: The completion-verify agent step has no loop breaker: tool_step_limit is never set on the primary verify step, leaving unbounded repetitive tool calls as the only failure mode

Runaway tool-call cycles (k-cycle with k>=2) are invisible to max_consecutive_repeat metric which only counts adjacent identical signatures; a windowed distinct-ratio discriminator (window=24, trip<=0.50) reliably separates pathological cycles from healthy breadth

When the agent exhausts its step budget during a loop, pydantic-ai raises UsageLimitExceeded which routes to LLMRunnerError; CompletionAgentStep.run catches only UnretryableOutputError so the typed branch never matches and bounded recovery is unreachable
A runaway tool loop must be detected and aborted mid-run by withdrawing tools or steering the model to emit a final answer, allowing bounded recovery to produce a verdict instead of dying empty

Both kill paths (request_limit and tool_calls_limit) are unbounded for the primary verify step; a runaway that burns tool calls without burning requests or vice versa can still exhaust the step budget
